about: On 2026-10-23 every number collision on the confirmed list that the review's sample left out, 55 in all (24 confirmed-contradiction, 31 updated-later), was read again (issue #155) as the review read its sample, with three differences. Five re-checkers read them, each given every fifth row, where the review gave its confirmed verdicts to three; each artifact whose page changed after the inventory read it was marked so, with what changed; and the re-checkers' brief, otherwise the review's, added one sentence: "This reading is the follow-up of issue #155: an earlier review drew two of these confirmed number verdicts at random and overturned both, so every one it left out is now read again." That sentence told the re-checkers that such verdicts had failed before, which may have made them readier to overturn, so the follow-up's rates are its own and not to be pooled with the review's. Each re-checker, told to overturn every verdict in its share and its hint, read both sources of each row and gave its own verdict, whether the hint was right and the words it rests on. Where a re-checker overturned a verdict or its hint, one of three judges read both readings and the sources and ruled; of the 20 rulings, 17 with the re-checker, 2 with the skeptic, 1 with neither. work/tools/reread_numbers.py writes the re-checkers' input again from the record as #137 merged it (commit fde5b06), and out/reread-confirmed-numbers.json holds each reading and ruling. The Any-View Spine Plan page changed three times after the inventory read it, all on 2026-10-22 and none in an accuracy figure: at 20:03 UTC its census paragraph, the per-region table of its section 4 and the next step of its section 5, and at 23:31 and 23:43 UTC its table of paired X-ray and CT sets and two notes under it. The re-checkers of rows 105, 106 and 107, which quote it, read it as it is now, with a note that named only the last two changes. The page is rendered from the artifacts' text as it is now, so one quote of the Renders cluster, row 45, is no longer found, the page writing 'unused; registration' where it wrote 'unused. Registration'.

They were ruled again in five groups: naming on whole lateral C-ArmLSpine frames (rows 0, 5, 6, 104, 105, 106 and 107); the 8,422 held-out crops (rows 61 and 111); the T12 and L1 shape test (rows 52 and 171); the coordbench plan's pairs and arms (rows 226 and 227); scopes the pages state or the readers computed (rows 24 and 31). One judge for each group read all of its rows together, each with both readings, its ruling and its verdict as the follow-up left it, and every source, the artifacts the review cited among them, with the review's points given as claims to check against the texts and never to take as true; the judge kept each row's verdict and hint or ruled it again. The Level Context Ladder (13 September) gives 96.7% exact and 99.7% within one at one vertebra visible for arms that join films to synthetic crops. The Reality Check (15 September) and the Corpus Audit (14 September) give 98.7% exact and 99.8% within one for a films-only model scored one crop at a time, against 99.4% for its recurrent head; the audit says that model's training bank holds films alone.
